verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some settlement legibility primitives. Transfers provide upfront fee quotes and track the lifecycle from initiation to completion or failure. The Checkouts API adds settlement details, deposits auto-credit the account balance, and fiat settlement is a named primitive. Missing for 10: documented timing from payment to available balance, a published fee schedule per rail (ACH/Fedwire/Swift/SEPA/onchain), and accounting-consumable statements or reports/exports.
